title: Early New Orleans bands Nash remembers
summary: Recalls an early Dixie Stompers band around 1908, then Celestin, Sam Morgan, Chris Kelly, Buddy Petit, Kid Rena and Armstrong bands.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well what other music did you hear before you started playing yourself?
Well, what kind of music did I hear?
Yeah, before you started playing yourself.

Well, I heard there used to be an old band around here called the New Orleans Dixie Stompers or something. I can't just remember the name but they had a saxophone, a bass, violin, and a guitar. That's been a long, long time. I can't even remember the guy's name but it's been a long time. That was way back in, that was right around back from 19, 19, 8. Around in 19, 8.
Do you remember any of the other guys? Huh? Who were some of the other early musicians you remember?

Well, after that then Sam Morgan. I mean Celestine was about the only best band that I could really remember around here, Papa Celestine. And then after Papa Celestine then it was Sam Morgan. After Sam Morgan then Chris Kelly had a band. After Chris Kelly then it was Buddy P.T. He had a band, played a trumpet. After Buddy P.T. then Kid Ran A. He up with a band. But Papa Celestine and Lou Armstrong, about the oldest two bands that I know around here. That's right, Papa Celestine and Lou Armstrong.
